name: arrow-right
description: Represents moving forward or pointing right. On hover the arrow nudges rightward, pointing the way.

animation.description: Shaft and head translate +3.5px on x and return (0.3s easeOut) — a pointing nudge in the direction of travel. One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context when used as a next-step or continue control.
